Ines Duarte: Hey everyone! I'm Ines — starting today on Infra. Super excited to join Redwood Inference. Quick setup questions: who should I ping for MDM enrollment and VPN access? Also would love a sticker pack if that's the thing :) Fun fact: I forage edible mushrooms around the city on weekends (totally safe stuff, promise).

Marco Li: Welcome Ines — glad to have you. Ping Eleni for MDM/VPN. What laptop did you get (Mac/Win/Linux)?

Ines Duarte: MacBook Pro (M3). I can generate an SSH key now if you want me to paste the public key here.

Eleni Park: congrats and welcome! I'll take MDM/VPN. If you paste your ssh pubkey I can add it to the ops jump host and CI deploy keys. Also will add you to the redwood-vpn group.

Ines Duarte: cool — here's the pubkey (copied from my laptop):
```
ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIKn7x4GxJYcQ3Z9fXy0W3Yqk1pLq2vF8t9hZsM1ines ines@personal-mbp
```

Eleni Park: got it, adding now. A couple of follow-ups: please check SSO invite in your email (from okta@redwood.ai) and accept it; you'll get device enrollment once that's done.

Juno (People Ops): welcome Ines! I'll drop a sticker + welcome note into your desk order and send the digital swag form. Quick ask: what's your t-shirt size?

Ines Duarte: thanks Juno — size M. Also thanks Eleni — I accepted the Okta invite a minute ago.

mdm-bot: MDM ticket #MDM-4521 created for Ines Duarte and assigned to Eleni Park. Estimated SLA: 4 business hours.

Eleni Park: ticket shows provisioning started. I'll add you to the infra Slack channel and grant jump host access in the next 15–30m. Marco, are you able to be Ines's buddy for the first week?

Marco Li: yep happy to. Let's do a short 1:1 at 3pm PT today to run through the repo layout, infra overview, and the lightweight onboarding checklist. I'll DM a calendar invite. Also lunch with the infra crew on Friday if you're free. :)

Ines Duarte: 3pm PT works great — thanks Marco. Really appreciate the quick help everyone. Looking forward to digging in! :raised_hands:
